data.body: fdd1 RED/GREEN: replaced REBAR_HLC kill-switch coverage with a retired-switch regression, dropped the seam marker budget to 4 total lines, regenerated env-vars, and rewrote the two compaction regression scenarios to use deterministic always-HLC timestamps.
